comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: "Absolutely mind-blowing! A half-million-line epic (20 times longer than the Iliad and Odyssey combined) that isn't preserved in books, but lives in the minds of reciters. Kyrgyzstan proves that sometimes humanity's greatest heritage isn't built of stone, but exists in the mind and nomadic culture. Brilliant documentary! 👏🏔

replies.author: @reallifeincountries
replies.text: "The Epic of Manas is truly one of the world's greatest oral traditions! 🇰🇬 📖 Preserving such immense history through oral recitation generation after generation is incredible. Thank you for this wonderful feedback!"
